jobs.title: Chief Courts Information Officer
jobs.description:
Job Description

On behalf of our public-sector client, Affinity is seeking a Chief Courts Information Officer to be accountable for the strategic leadership, governance, and delivery of information management (IM), information technology (IT), and digital services for the Courts. The CCIO ensures that court information systems, digital services, and technology investments support judicial independence, court administration, access to justice, operational efficiency, privacy, and security.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement information management strategies and polices to ensure the secure and efficient handling of Court information.
Project management, change management and strategic planning processes for the effective delivery and management of both short and long-term information technology goals set by the judiciary.
Represent the interests of the judiciary recognizing judicial independence in their day-today operations of and/or projects involving implementing and/or updating software, databases and digital tools used by the judiciary or involving judicial data and court information.
Must operate with full confidence of the Chief Justices and the Chief Judge, be discreet as required and understand the highly confidential and sensitive nature of the work that they perform.
The Chief Court Information Officer (“CCIO”) must have the ability to work cooperatively and harmoniously with all members of the judiciary and both senior and front-line court administration staff, as we as internal and external stakeholders.
Lead the modernization of court information systems, including case management, e-filing, digital evidence, and courtroom technology.

Qualifications

Education and/or training involving computer science, information technology, cyber security or related field.
Significant work experience, preferably 5 years or more, in information technology and information governance, with a focus on cybersecurity and records retention.
Strong understanding of legal and regulatory requirements related to information management, cybersecurity, and records retention.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop and implement effective information management strategies for an increasingly digital legal work environment.
Extensive experience conducting IT and information security research and providing advice and opinions, preferably at a senior executive level.
Demonstrated ability to prepare written opinions, memoranda and reports.
The incumbent must have a superior understanding of the principles of judicial independence and possess strong political acumen and experience in the application of discretion and diplomacy to ensure positive outcomes and confidence in the administration of justice.
Well-developed planning and organizational skills in order to accomplish the position’s responsibilities and meet target dates and set priorities.
Experience using MS Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Outlook and online legal research databases which may be used by the judiciary. Familiarity with JUDICLOUD (federally appointed judges email network) and/or PowerBI is considered an asset.
Stakeholder engagement - Build effective relationships with the judiciary, court administrators, justice partners, central government IT organizations, and external stakeholders.
Represent the Courts on inter jurisdictional, justice sector, and government technology forums, as required.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
On-site attendance is a mandatory requirement for this role.
Must be able to provide a satisfactory criminal record check and security clearance.
The Resource will be required to execute a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and maintain strict confidentiality with respect to all information obtained or accessed in the course of performing the Services.
Relevant certifications such as the Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
A law degree from an accredited university or college recognized in Manitoba.

Affinity Earn

Know someone who’s great for this, or any of our open roles? Earn up to $4,000/year for each successful referral through Affinity Earn. You can also earn up to $50,000 for helping us find new clients. Learn about our referral program at https://affinity-group.ca/earn/ or browse our jobs & follow us at https://www.linkedin.com/company/affinity-staffing/jobs/

About Affinity

Affinity Group is a technology and business consulting and services company. We believe in creating long term relationships between clients and consultants that foster a mutually beneficial partnership. Affinity is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

For more information on Affinity, please visit www.affinity-group.ca

jobs.title: Director of Digital Products, Ad Experiences and Audience Activation (Hybrid/Telework)
jobs.description:
Position Title

Director of Digital Products, Ad Experiences and Audience Activation (Hybrid/Telework)

Status Of Employment

Permanent

Position Language Requirement

English, French

Language Skills

English (Reading - C - Advanced), English (Speaking - C - Advanced), English (Writing - B - Intermediate), French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - C - Advanced), French (Writing - B - Intermediate)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date

2026-11-01 11:59 PM

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Job Overview

This position is part of the Digital Media department, which oversees CBC and Radio-Canada’s flagship digital products.

In partnership with the Media Solutions division, the person in this role plays a key role in shaping the vision for CBC-RC monetization experience evolution. They leverage a deep understanding of digital, user behaviours, market trends, and technology to inform strategic thinking and guide product direction. They also will support the day to day audience segmentation activities and support and inform the monetization data strategy and roadmaps.

They lead the monetization products evolution — from testing to discovery to delivery — balancing user needs with business objectives. They work to enhance the overall experience and drive innovation to retain current clients, audiences and attract new ones. They also ensure the continuous evolution of tools and solutions that support Media Solutions and Marketing team operations as it relates to audience segmentation.

They collaborate with product managers to coordinate the work carried out by the product teams. They maintain strong ties with the sales, marketing, communications, and ad tech teams to ensure strategic and operational alignment.

This role also aims to create synergies across products to strengthen engagement within Radio-Canada’s broader digital ecosystem. The individual actively contributes to the organization’s digital transformation initiatives.

Why This Role Is Important

You are responsible for leading and evolving the organizations ability to drive revenue through the creation and maintenance of innovative ad products and services.
You are responsible for developing a strategic roadmap that aligns to the strategic priorities of the Media Solutions (Sales) team, by identifying and executing on the highest priorities.
You enable the evolution of ad formats, the integration of technologies within the ad tech stack, the evolution of the data strategy and the enablement of key features and improvements for our users.
You establish a testing practice that is continuously finding ways to improve the existing ad experience with new ad loads, scenarios by user type and ad formats to adopt.
You are in lock step with the strategy of the Media Solutions team. The products that your teams develop are relevant in the market and sellable.
You enable real collaboration between your stakeholders and the product teams focusing them on solving problems together.
You are the main point of accountability and escalation to Media Solutions as it relates to product development.
You coach and mentor a cross functional team of product managers, data analysts and data experts.

Core Competencies / Mindset

This role requires a proactive and collaborative leader who acts as a crucial link between technical possibilities and business needs:

Problem Solver & Roadblock Remover: key to understanding what is possible, navigating the entire team around roadblocks, and creating options and alternatives to respond to business problems
Collaborative Leader: creates a positive and collaborative space that fosters deeper understanding between supported teams, often by facilitating meetings as forums for problem-solving
Clarity & Accountability: key to creating clarity on the roadmap, ensuring decisions are made, and escalating effectively to clear the path on execution
Efficiency Driver: focused on making things easier, faster, smoother, and better, including filling gaps personally with conversations and trackers, and coaching resources on performance
Client Service Mindset: sets high standards, seeks out feedback, acts on it, and ensures teams are serving stakeholders appropriately
Action-Oriented & Transparent: strongly biased towards action, pushing for ways forward with personal involvement over passing the buck. Works transparently, ensuring risks are appropriately distributed across all decision makers rather than made in silos
Product Leader: reinforces basic product principles, helps teams find effective ways forward, emphasizing the quest for value over increments of work

How You Will Make An Impact

You will work closely with your partners in Media Solutions - from Ad Tech, Ad Operations and Data Monetization to understand their needs to deepen the nature of the relationship. You will invest the time in understanding their strategic roadmaps and the most important problems to solve.
You will work closely with a team of product managers to ensure that roadmaps reflect the priorities and needs of the stakeholders and you will make sure the teams are focused on the right things. You will make sure that the product teams are delivering real value to your stakeholders.
You will enable the generation of revenue through the activation of audiences first party data.

Candidate Qualifications

Minimum of five to seven (5 to 7) years of progressive leadership within the media or advertising industry
Deep expertise in advertising, digital transformation, and multi-platform consumer behaviour
Demonstrated adaptability in dynamic environments with the resilience to navigate ambiguity and lead organizational change
Exceptional communication and presentation skills; bilingual proficiency in French and English is highly desirable
Superior relationship management skills with a proven ability to influence senior executives through diplomacy and strategic negotiation
Ability to manage competing priorities and high-pressure deadlines with operational excellence

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:

A mandatory Criminal record check.
Other background checks may be conducted based on the operational requirements of the position.

That’s because we can only create and tell the stories that connect Canadians, by having a workforce that mirrors the ever-changing makeup of our country. That’s why we, as an employer, value equal opportunity and nurture an inclusive workplace where our individual differences are not only recognized and valued, but also extend to and pervade all the services we provide as Canada’s public broadcaster. For more information, visit the Diversity and Inclusion section of our website. If you have accommodation needs at this stage of the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible by sending an e-mail to recruitment@cbc.ca.

You are invited to consult and familiarize yourself with our Code of Conduct, which can be found on our corporate website. All employees must adhere to the Code as a condition of employment. We also invite you to take a look at our policy on conflicts of interest. In the event that you become an employee, it will be important to inform us, as quickly as possible, of any situation that, because of your hiring, constitutes or could appear to constitute a conflict of interest.

jobs.title: Associate Vice President, Corporate Finance
jobs.description:
Federated Co-operatives Limited (FCL) is hiring an Associate Vice President, Corporate Finance
on a permanent full-time basis within our Finance team. This position is a hybrid
opportunity and is based in Saskatoon, SK
.

Corporate Finance plays a critical role in shaping the financial strength and long-term success of FCL. As the Associate Vice President, Corporate Finance, you'll provide leadership across Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Accounting, Treasury & Credit and Risk & Insurance ensuring the function delivers strong financial stewardship, insight and support for FCL’s enterprise priorities. This is an opportunity to influence executive decision-making, build high-performing teams, and help strengthen FCL’s long term financial performance.

What you’ll do:

Lead Corporate Finance as an integrated, high performing function, ensuring alignment across Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Accounting, Treasury, Credit and Insurance while fostering strong collaboration, clear accountabilities, operational excellence and strong business partnerships across FCL.
Serve as a key strategic partner to the Vice President Finance, helping translate enterprise priorities into action while providing trusted advice and independent financial perspective that supports sound enterprise decision-making, capital allocation, and long-term organizational performance.
Oversee enterprise financial planning and analysis, financial reporting, and controllership ensuring accurate financial information, meaningful business insights, and disciplined financial stewardship.
Guide treasury, credit, and financial risk strategies to support FCL's long-term financial sustainability and strategic objectives.
Champion strong governance and financial controls while driving continuous improvement across Corporate Finance.
Provide leadership for Corporate Finance led strategic initiatives and support broader enterprise initiatives as required, ensuring strong Corporate Finance alignment, support and execution.
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing leadership team while fostering a culture of collaboration, performance, accountability, and continuous improvement across Corporate Finance.

Who you’ll work with:

The Team:
Reporting to the Vice President, Finance, you'll lead a diverse team of finance leaders, including the Director, Corporate Accounting, Director, Financial Planning & Analysis, Senior Manager, Treasury & Credit and Manager, Risk & Insurance. You'll work closely with the Vice President Finance and Leaders across FCL to advance enterprise and Finance priorities while ensuring Corporate Finance provides strong financial leadership, insight and support to the organization.

Why it matters:

We help local Co-ops grow and thrive by offering a range of professional services, including marketing, market research, information technology, human resources, accounting, risk management and business development.

Who you are:

You are looking for a career in Finance and:
Have 15+ years of progressive finance leadership experience across multiple disciplines, including Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Accounting, Treasury, Corporate Finance, Capital Planning, or Risk Management.
Have a degree in Business or Commerce. An MBA, CFA, CBV or equivalent advanced designation considered an asset.
Hold a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation.

What we offer:

Competitive salaries, short-term incentives, a comprehensive benefits package, and an employer-contributed pension plan.
Encouragement to take advantage of learning opportunities to grow and develop as a Team Member.
As a co-operative, we do business differently. We believe in working together to serve Western Canadians, delivering profits back to our communities and investing in sustainable growth. To learn more about who we are and what we offer, visit www.fcl.crs.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process to ensure an enjoyable candidate experience. If you require an accommodation during the recruitment process, we invite you to submit your requests to us via fclhr@fcl.crs. All information received will be kept confidential.

If this opportunity speaks to you, we invite you to apply by September 27, 2026
.

We thank all candidates for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the recruitment process will be contacted.

As this position is considered a position of trust, you may be required to complete a criminal record check in accordance with FCL policies.

FCL embraces diversity and inclusion. We’re working to create a workforce that is as diverse as the communities we serve and an environment where every team member brings their whole self to work. We believe all candidates should feel at home with us and be given the opportunity to fully participate during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Principal Enterprise Architect (Director)
jobs.description:
Salary Range

138,400.00 - 188,400.00 CAD

Principal Enterprise Architect (Director)

We are ready to take this game to the next level and need a strategic and influential Principal Enterprise Architect (Director)
to lead the development and evolution of the enterprise architecture strategy, roadmap, and governance framework across business, application, data, and technology domains. As a trusted advisor to executive and business leaders, this role aligns technology investments and transformation initiatives with corporate objectives, driving business growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction, innovation, and customer value. The Principal Enterprise Architect develops target-state architectures, business capability models, and enterprise roadmaps that guide strategic decision-making, investment planning, and modernization efforts, while fostering cross-functional collaboration and ensuring measurable business outcomes through effective governance, application portfolio optimization, and technology enablement.

YOUR ROLE IN THE GAME

Reporting to the Head of Enterprise Architecture, you will be empowered to:

Develop enterprise-wide architecture and processes. Lead the creation of new systems capability strategies aligned with business requirements.
Develop technology roadmaps for enterprise architecture aligned with organizational plans and initiatives, and emerging technology solutions and influence stakeholders to obtain commitment to roadmaps.
Develop business cases (e.g., cost/benefit analysis, impact and risk analysis, etc.) for each option for approval, funding and prioritization.
Set strategies, policies, standards and practices and ensure compliance.
Lead and plan the development and implementation of innovation processes, tools, and frameworks.
Seek out, identify, propose, prioritize, and initiate capability improvement activities and lead substantial improvement programs. Select frameworks, approaches, and techniques for use.
Lead and manage the creation or review of a strategy that meets the requirements of the business . Set policies, standards, and guidelines for strategy development and planning and select appropriate methods and tools.
Identify risks arising from potential solution architectures and design solutions to mitigate identified risks.
Determine governance requirements reflecting the organization's values, ethics, risk appetite, and wider governance frameworks. Communicate delegated authority, benefits, opportunities, costs and risks.
Create bespoke business models for non-standard contexts and align with the overall business strategy.
Coach colleagues to develop their target skills and capabilities in line with team and personal goals.
Allocate routine tasks or project work, in line with team objectives and individual capabilities. Monitor quality and performance against agreed criteria to make learning recommendations or to escalate concerns.
Help individuals navigate areas of uncertainty, offering practical advice and connecting them with the appropriate resources when needed.
Support learning and development activities under routine supervision.

Education & Experience

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE GAME

Post-secondary degree, preferably in information technology, business administration and/or project management, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Minimum fifteen (15) years’ experience in progressively advancing roles within Technology or a related function.
10+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, with significant experience leading Application Portfolio Management (APM) initiatives across large, complex organizations.
Experience developing application rationalization strategies that reduce technical debt, eliminate redundancy, and optimize technology investments.
Proven ability to assess application business value, technical fit, operational risk, and total cost of ownership (TCO) to support investment decisions.
Led portfolio modernization efforts, including cloud transformation, SaaS adoption, legacy system retirement, and technology standardization initiatives.
Experience developing and implementing business and application architectures within the technology function of an organization.
Experience collaborating with product owners and delivery teams to define, design, and deliver roadmaps and architecture patterns is preferred.
Experience with lottery and gaming organizations or related sectors with an understanding of associated business-related capabilities and underlying required business and technology solutions is an asset.

Relevant Skills

Enterprise and Business Architecture - Aligning an organization’s technology strategy with its business mission, strategy and processes and documenting this using architectural models.
Strategic Planning - Creating and maintaining organizational-level strategies to align overall business plans, actions and resources with high-level business objectives
Emerging Technology Monitoring - Identifying and assessing new and emerging technologies, products, services, methods and techniques.
Strong governance, negotiation, and decision-making skills to balance business priorities, technology risks, and architectural standards.
Expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks and practices, including TOGAF, capability-based planning, business architecture, and technology strategy development.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex portfolio insights into executive-level business outcomes.

Benefits Of Joining The Winning Team

Group Benefits Plan: Comprehensive, employer-paid group benefits coverage.
Variable Pay Program: Participation in a performance-based incentive plan that recognizes organizational and individual achievements.
Public Service Pension Plan: Participation in a highly desirable defined benefit pension plan.
Paid Time-Off: Competitive paid time-off provisions to support work-life balance and well-being.
Growth Focus: Become your best self with comprehensive support for your professional development.
Equity, diversity, and inclusion: Core to OLG’s culture, empowering employees to bring their authentic selves and make a meaningful impact across Ontario.

To learn more about our organization and other opportunities visit our career site.

We look forward to hearing from you, interested applicants please apply online by November 1, 2026.

Please Note:
Unless otherwise specified, all positions are required to work fully onsite.

OLG is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Please contact Human Resources at careers@olg.ca if you require accommodation at any time throughout the hire process.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. If you bring relevant skills and a willingness to learn, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every listed qualification. jobs.title: Director, Data Centres and New Large Loads - Power Market
jobs.description:
Type of position:
Regular

An Overview Of Your Future Role At BBA

BBA supports all players across the energy ecosystem, including power generation, transmission and distribution. We also support large industrial energy users, mainly in the mining, oil and gas sectors. More recently, we’ve seen growing demand from a new category of large energy consumers, particularly data centres. To date, BBA’s involvement in the data centre market has been largely reactive, with developers and builders reaching out to us for our expertise in grid interconnections and power systems. Going forward, BBA will take a deliberate and proactive approach to this market by establishing a dedicated data centre business line.

Drawing On More Than 45 Years Of Experience Solving Complex Electrical Challenges, BBA’s Go-to-market Strategy Will Be Guided By The Following Principles

Avoid commodity building design and leverage strategic partnerships where appropriate
Focus on projects larger than 25 MW
Lead the high-voltage scope
Lead grid integration activities
Lead substation design and delivery
Lead generation strategy development

An Overview Of Your Mandates And Responsibilities

You'll source and ensure successful delivery of power projects to meet the energy needs of large-load clients, primarily data centres. You’ll also occasionally support other industrial, community and utility clients operating in remote or partially grid‑connected environments. Initially, the role will focus on regional clients across Canada and gradually expand to include the U.S. market.

As a renewable power professional, you’ll lead the modelling, optimization and delivery of complex energy projects involving renewable technologies, including wind, solar PV, BESS, thermal and hydroelectric power. Your work will include studies, roadmaps and project execution.

BBA operates within a matrix structure, and the New Large Loads business line you’ll lead has both national and international focus. The business line is accountable for defining market strategy and overseeing sector performance. To deliver on its mandates, it works closely with BBA’s operational teams and disciplines across Canada and the USA. While most projects are executed through these regional teams, the business line may also directly manage and deliver certain strategic initiatives.

Business development

Coordinate the development and execution of BBA’s data centre market strategy
Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders across the data centre, utilities and industrial sectors
Support the development of short‑, medium‑ and long‑term opportunity pipelines while identifying cross‑selling opportunities for BBA’s services
Support project sourcing efforts by identifying opportunities that align with regional priorities across Canada and evolving data centre power needs
Contribute to proposal development, client positioning and pursuit strategies for power and energy mandates
Maintain a strong understanding of energy market trends, particularly for data centres, off‑grid, hybrid and utility‑linked power systems

Operations

Serve as project manager and technical lead for selected strategic projects, including project development support, feasibility studies, roadmaps and execution mandates
Provide subject‑matter expertise in the modelling, optimization and integration of renewable and hybrid power systems (wind, solar PV, CSP, BESS, thermal storage, hydroelectric)
Oversee technical reviews and coordinate engineering and design activities across disciplines
Work closely with BBA’s multidisciplinary teams across Canada to ensure execution excellence and alignment with client objectives
Help develop internal expertise in data centre development, power system optimization, hybrid energy solutions and renewable integration
Support the development of tools, methodologies and reference models for studies, roadmaps and system optimization
Participate in knowledge sharing and thought leadership activities, including internal training, technical contributions and industry engagements

Do your qualities and values match our corporate culture?

Business acumen
Strategic vision
Action and results-driven
Ability to see beyond established standards
Constantly seeking sustainable and agile solutions
Rigour and ethical
Accountability and entrepreneurship
Client-oriented with existing network
Organizational agility

An ov
erview of BBA’s total rewards

Annual premium program for regular employees
Onsite mobility premium
Time bank
Cellphone fee reimbursements
Group insurance plan from the first day of employment, including disability insurance and a telemedicine program
Retirement savings plan
Annual vacation and sick leave
Premium for employee referrals

BBA considers many factors when determining the annual base salary, including location, market, education, relevant and demonstrated work experience, technical assessment, qualifications, certifications and other relevant skills.

Summary Of Certifications And Job Requirements

Engineering degree in a related discipline from a recognized university
At least 15 years of relevant experience
Experience in data centre development and execution, wind and/or solar power energy, consulting engineering, business development and project execution
Registered as a Professional Engineer in Canada
Experience in equipment selection, capital cost and operating cost estimates
Available to travel to domestic or international destinations is required

About BBA

BBA is one of Canada’s leading private consulting engineering firms, with over 45 years of experience serving the energy and natural resources industry.

Our people are the foundation of our success. Their passion and excellence have earned us recognition as one of Canada’s Best Employers and Best Managed Companies , and we’re committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels empowered to grow, lead and be themselves.

Our teams bring together engineering, environmental and commissioning expertise to deliver practical, innovative and sustainable solutions—from strategy to execution. With 20 offices across Canada, the U.S. and Latin America, we combine local presence with international reach, offering clients close collaboration and field-ready support.

Learn more about our culture and projects on LinkedIn or connect with our talent team.
